story: Egertton grew the most since 23 Nov: +8.1% (about 24K new listeners), likely off their new single "Big Professor" (out 19 Nov). scottyolorin was close behind at +5.4%.
Mavo is the biggest UG act right now with 3.8M monthly listeners, about as many listeners as ODUMODUBLVCK.
By our meter, Mavo has crossed over to mainstream-level numbers, and Zaylevelten is breaking through.
